notes: Modified cash basis school district. Top-level figures are from the Statement of Receipts, Disbursements, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p4), Total Governmental Funds column. beginning_cash = fund balance beginning of year 65,495,960 (cash basis, p4); ending_cash = total assets of governmental funds 93,654,468 (p3: cash 14,083,350 + County Treasurer 11,458,396 + investments 68,112,722). Investments not added separately. Identity: 65,495,960 + 173,701,223 - 168,199,266 + 5,497,365 - 5,497,365 + 20,120,000 (bond issuance) + 2,536,551 (bond premium) = 93,654,468. Statement 'Interest' line prints a dash in all columns; interest is inside Local receipts. Local receipts (46,817,144) is split into 10 lines using the fund schedules' local lines (property tax 36,960,849; motor vehicle 4,741,238; carline 19,516; interest 1,754,823; license fees 197,563; fines 13,488; private grants 348,666; SPED tuition 76,834; Special Building local other 211,715) plus a 2,492,452 residual marked review (local receipts of funds whose schedules are not in the trimmed PDF, e.g. Activities); the pieces sum to exactly 46,817,144. Debt service is one line (principal and interest). No business-type funds (school nutrition is in governmental funds), business_type null. Balance sheet = Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis, Governmental Activities column (no total primary government column; component unit Central Nebraska Education Agency excluded). Detail: General Fund budgetary comparison (pp5-7, report pp29-31) and other fund budget schedules pp8-15; zero-actual lines in the General Fund schedule (e.g. 1990, 2130 zero lines, 3540, 4422, 4510, 4709, 4709) omitted because they add nothing. General Fund schedule actual covers only the General Fund itself; the statement's General Fund column also includes the Depreciation, Employee Benefit and Contingency funds (153,232,251+254,168+151,102+51,092=153,688,613; disbursements 129,422,371+433,928+14,232=129,870,531 ties). The General Fund 8000 transfer 5,497,365 equals statement transfers out; receiving transfers: Depreciation 4,000,000 plus other funds 1,497,365 (nutrition 600,000 + activities etc. on pages not in the trimmed PDF). Trimmed PDF skips report p39 (probably the Activities fund schedule) between trimmed pp14 and 15. Detail disbursement lines are by program code with no object breakdown, so not itemized. Net position basis: p1 shows fund-level equity differently from the fund balance statement (fund balances 93,654,468 vs net position 156,080,315 includes capital assets less debt). Read pages 1-15 of 15
